1.purpose: Opens exactly on the canonical master composition (halys_wide3): river straight to the sun at the vanishing point, Lydians left, Medes right, mirrored, armies in parade ranks (plate 0-4.5 s). Then the camera descends (4.5-8.5 s) as both armies surge into the river, ending in a ground-level melee in the ford (8.5-15 s).
1.costume: Lydians crested helmets, crimson tunics, crimson lion shields; Medes red caps, ochre tunics, wicker shields; standards on poles (lion, horse), no flags.
1.identity: Army-level; the close melee figures at 12-15 s read as the two sides.
1.artefacts: None seen at sheet scale; dense melee in the last 3 s should not be used for figure work.
1.notes: 1:1 from t0 fits S05 (title, plate 0-3.5) and S06 (descent, plate 3.5-7.0) exactly. For later wides (S16, S20, S24, S30, S35, S44) use plate 0-4.5 (static master). No battle at the ford in the high part (armies in ranks).
